verdict.rationale: Marqeta exposes webhooks for event-driven notifications, JIT funding for autonomous approve/deny decisioning, and an MCP server letting AI agents query/act on Core API endpoints — building blocks that support background automation, but there's no dedicated workflow/scheduler feature; automation must be built by the user's own system consuming these APIs.  missing for 10: a first-party automation/orchestration or scheduling feature, evidence of agents running persistent unattended background jobs rather than reactive API calls.
